sourceDate.text: 兩宮西巡、兩宮西狩、兩宮西幸
兩宮西巡、兩宮西狩、兩宮西幸

translationRepairs: When the two empress dowagers fled west, he hurried to join the court in exile, was named Vice Minister of Rites, and became a lecturer at the imperial classics lecture.
When the Empress Dowager and the Emperor fled west, he hurried to join the court in exile, was named Vice Minister of Rites, and became a lecturer at the imperial classics lecture.
s0010 兩宮西巡 in this Guangxu-era western flight denotes the Empress Dowager and the Emperor together; "two empress dowagers" misreads 兩宮, and the proposed wording is accurate.
When the two empress dowagers toured westward, he rushed to the imperial retinue, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites, and served as lecturer at the classics lecture.
When the Empress Dowager and the Emperor toured westward, he rushed to the imperial retinue, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites, and served as lecturer at the classics lecture.
Same unit s0010: literal "two empress dowagers" mistranslates 兩宮; "the Empress Dowager and the Emperor" matches Qing court usage for that phrase.
In the twenty-sixth year, when the allied powers entered Beijing and the two empress dowagers fled west, he was mourning his father and was ordered to stay in the capital to manage affairs.

In the twenty-sixth year, when the allied powers entered Beijing and the Empress Dowager and the Emperor fled west, he was mourning his father and was ordered to stay in the capital to manage affairs.
s0069 兩宮西狩 in Guangxu 26 (1900) is the Empress Dowager and Emperor fleeing west with the allied entry into Beijing; "two empress dowagers" is factually wrong.
When the empress dowagers returned, he was given the yellow riding jacket, moved to the Ministry of Personnel, and also served as banner general.
When the Empress Dowager and the Emperor returned, he was given the yellow riding jacket, moved to the Ministry of Personnel, and also served as banner general.
s0072 兩宮回鑾 means the same sovereign pair returning to the capital; plural "empress dowagers" alone invents two dowagers and omits the emperor.
When the Boxer calamity broke out and the two empress dowagers fled west, Dingfen was first to propose presenting local tribute products.
When the Boxer calamity broke out and the Empress Dowager and the Emperor fled west, Dingfen was first to propose presenting local tribute products.
s0153 兩宮西幸 amid the Boxer calamity again means the Empress Dowager and Emperor going west; the proposed replacement corrects the misreading without other changes.
When the two empress dowagers passed away, he rushed to attend the mourning rites and left the next day; Zhidong was then in the Grand Council, yet Dingfen did not once go to pay his respects.

When the Empress Dowager and the Emperor passed away, he rushed to attend the mourning rites and left the next day; Zhidong was then in the Grand Council, yet Dingfen did not once go to pay his respects.
s0164 兩宮升遐 refers to the deaths of the Empress Dowager and the Emperor (1908), not two empress dowagers; the replacement is accurate and grammatical.
